verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Relay lets you open up to 20 checking accounts and auto-transfer every deposit, using dollar amounts or percentages split across multiple accounts. The Profit First setup shows sub-accounts nicknamed by purpose. Community sources independently confirm the many free checking accounts and the automatic partitioning of money. One community review mentions occasional glitches with account transfers, which keeps confidence from being absolute but does not contradict the capability. Missing for 10: detailed step-by-step setup docs for the deposit auto-allocation rules (e.g., trigger conditions and rule limits).
